## Tools & Dashboards 🛠️

### [SIYA: Sistema de Indicadores de los YA](https://ninezya.org/siya/)
Indicators on **childhood and adolescence** for the NiñezYA coalition. I was part of the team that built them from administrative and survey data and kept them updated across three releases ([code on GitHub](https://github.com/dfmendivelso10/Ninez-YA)).

### [Maternal and Child Health Dashboard](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/maternoinfantil/)
**22+ maternal and child health indicators** for 1,101 municipalities, made for Fundación Éxito. I worked on extracting and cleaning the administrative data behind them.

### [Prevalence and Nature of CSEA: Interactive Data Tool](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/prevalence-csea/)
Data on **child sexual exploitation and abuse in 17 countries**, from the Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys (VACS). I helped harmonize the microdata that feeds the tool.

## Working Papers & Publications 📝

### Intergenerational transmission of childhood adversity in Colombia
A **working paper in preparation** studying 163 caregiver–child dyads on how Adverse Childhood Experiences are transmitted to child socioemotional outcomes, using mediation analysis within a structural equation framework. Co-author.

### Prevalence and measurement of childhood adversity in Bogotá public services
A **working paper in preparation** on 346 adolescents and young adults across 18 localities, survey-weighted to represent 1.8M residents, introducing a participatory measurement instrument. Co-author.

### Prevalence and Nature of Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse
A **technical report (in submission)** based on VACS microdata from 17 countries. I assembled and maintained the research datasets behind it.
